blocks.title: Binge Hongguo short dramas without leaving Youth
blocks.description: A Youth-managed vertical player for Hongguo short dramas: immersive swipe playback, autoplay, search and rankings, with cache and data tools one conversation away. The player downloads on demand, so the install stays small.

showcase.user_prompt: Pick an easy short drama to watch over dinner — two episodes, then clean the cache for me.
showcase.assistant_reply: Opened Hongguo and autoplaying your show. Tell me when you're done and I'll clean this session's cache — login, favorites and history stay untouched.

items.title: One-click launch
items.description: Open it from the sidebar panel, or just say "open Hongguo" in a conversation — no hunting for the executable.

items.title: AI chat control
items.description: "Open Hongguo", "close Hongguo", "is Hongguo running" — control playback without switching windows.

items.title: Cache and data tools
items.description: Reclaim disk with one click while login, favorites and watch history stay untouched, or erase everything for a fresh start.

items.title: Full playback experience
items.description: Immersive vertical feed, wheel-to-switch episodes, autoplay, search and rankings, follow updates, always-on-top mini window, HEVC hardware decoding.

items.title: Enable the ability
items.description: After installing, enable it here and grant the process and filesystem permissions the launcher needs (all through audited host channels).

items.title: Open the player
items.description: Click Hongguo in the sidebar and hit the launch button, or just ask in a conversation.

items.title: Watch and manage
items.description: The first launch sets up decoding components automatically; stop the player or clean the cache from the panel whenever you like.

blocks.title: Before you start
blocks.content: The player is an unofficial third-party client for personal study use, not affiliated with this ability or Youth. It is not code-signed, so some antivirus tools may flag it — add the install folder to your whitelist, and allow it through the firewall if local playback fails.

The player binary is not bundled: it downloads on first launch from the plugin's release mirror (about 27 MB) and follows the version manifest for updates. Uninstalling the ability keeps your player data. For in-player actions such as logging in, searching or picking a show, the bundled Skill drives the interface through the cua-driver ability (background input with the on-screen AI banner) or host UI automation — it never grabs your mouse and keyboard.

The Hongguo short-drama player is an unofficial third-party client for personal study use, with no affiliation to Hongguo or Youth. Player data lives in %APPDATA%\hgplayer on this machine; uninstalling the ability does not delete it.
